meta.purpose: Three more of Mr Tan's medicines, laid out on an example account only (scene 3 of the owner's demo video, 10-15: he faces four medicines and has forgotten how much of each to take). Read by web/lib/story/example-meds.ts; the story template (timeline.seed.json) is unchanged.
meta.story: Prescribed and dispensed at Blossom Family Clinic (fictional) together with his amlodipine: the labels carry the same dispensing date as amlodipine's (v2, day 8, dates in the template's calendar and moved to the account's days like amlodipine's), taken from day 9 on. No visit recording mentions them, so no visit is named as where they were prescribed and no doctor's words are linked to them.
meta.doses: Every slot each medicine is taken in, every day from start_day to the day before today: taken, except a morning on which the template's own log has his morning tablet missed (the four tai chi mornings): then every morning medicine is missed, with the same reason in his words.
meta.note: Fictional, as the rest of the persona. The label lines are exactly what the printed labels for the film say (D:/ripple-c2/print/medicine-labels-1015).
